headline: Your wound looks mostly healed but there is some mild redness beyond the stitch line.

reasons.finding: pinkish redness visible beyond the incision line (distance unclear)

steps: Check your temperature twice today and tomorrow.
Keep the wound clean and dry; avoid tight clothing over the area.
Watch for increasing redness, new discharge, worsening pain, or fever ≥38°C.
Contact your surgical team if any of these changes occur.
message_to_team: Hi team, on day 30 my groin incision is closed with staples, pain 0/10, temperature 36.6°C, no discharge. I see some pinkish redness beyond the stitch line that wasn’t present before. No fever or worsening pain. Please advise if I should come in for a check.
photo_words: The wound is closed with small dark fasteners (staples or suture points) spaced along a linear incision. Pinkish redness is visible beyond the thin incision line, but a distance cannot be clearly measured. No obvious swelling is visible. A small dark brown/black crust is present at the upper end of the incision, with no other discharge seen. The edges appear approximated (not apart), and no clear bruising is visible.
